test_euclidean_projection: test euclidean_projection_onto_simplex to project a vector onto the probability simplex
test_tangent_projection: test project_grad to project a gradient onto the tangent space of the simplex
test_grad_norm: test grad_norm to compute the norm of a gradient projected onto the simplex tangent space
build_euclidean_projection: build a Euclidean projection of a vector onto the probability simplex using euclidean_projection_onto_simplex
build_tangent_projection: build a gradient projection onto the tangent space of the simplex using project_grad
